name: Suggestions
purpose: Follow-up chips and prompt-starter cards that send or insert a prompt.
description: Follow-up prompts and prompt starters. Chips sit in one row that scrolls sideways with soft faded edges; cards make a grid of starters for an empty conversation. Each chip either sends its prompt or inserts it into the Prompt input for editing. Part of the Agent kit.

suggestions.notes: Figma: Items — strings or items with a separate prompt, description and icon.

onSelect.notes: Called with the chosen prompt and the item.

mode.notes: Figma: Action. `send` (default) — choosing a chip sends the prompt right away. `insert` — puts the prompt into the input so the person can edit it first.

variant.notes: Figma: Style. `chips` (default) — one row of pills that scrolls sideways (wraps with `wrap`). `cards` — a grid of prompt starters for a welcome state.

wrap.notes: Chips wrap onto several lines instead of scrolling

do: Write chips as the person would type them, in their voice: "Fix the contrast issue".
Use Insert when the prompt needs a detail the person must add.
Replace follow-ups after every answer; remove them when the person starts typing.
forbidden: Never show more than five chips or four cards at once.
Never use Suggestions for actions that change data without a message — use Button.

examples.title: Usage
examples.code:
import { Suggestions } from '@stanvision/atomus-react';

<Suggestions suggestions={['Fix the contrast issue', 'Show the axe report']} onSelect={send} />
<Suggestions mode="insert" suggestions={['Make it shorter']} onSelect={(p) => setDraft(p)} />
<Suggestions variant="cards" suggestions={starters} onSelect={send} />

notes: Write chips as the person would type them, in their voice: "Fix the contrast issue".
